items.title: Isidore Barbarin Interview, 1959-01-07
items.q: Eddie Jackson was playing with the band I was with when he died.

ctx.x: Hmm-hmm. The bass drum. And let's see, what am I leaving out now in that band? Oh, Eddie Jackson. Eddie Jackson. Did he play with that band?
Eddie Jackson was playing with the band I was with when he died. He died at the hospital.
He was in the Onward. Huh? He was in the Onward? In the Onward? O-B-B? He wasn't...
